title.zh: Anthropic’s Claude helped 3 researchers breach OpenAI in under 72 hours
title.en: Anthropic’s Claude helped 3 researchers breach OpenAI in under 72 hours

current_state.zh: Security researchers at Hacktron used Anthropic's Claude to chain an image-processing vulnerability with an OpenAI identity flaw, breaching employee ChatGPT and Codex accounts and reaching an internal OpenAI code repository within 72 hours.
current_state.en: Security researchers at Hacktron used Anthropic's Claude to chain an image-processing vulnerability with an OpenAI identity flaw, breaching employee ChatGPT and Codex accounts and reaching an internal OpenAI code repository within 72 hours.
